Logos read clearly on hover again, JDownloader keeps itself up to date, and the working folder says it is optional.

## ✨ Added

- **JDownloader updates itself.** The JDownloader backend card under Settings, General, Updates has an Update automatically switch, on by default. Once a day KnightLoader asks JDownloader for an update and installs it while none of its downloads is running. If one is running, it tries again an hour later.

## 🎨 Design

- **Logos on hover.** In the windows where you pick an account or a hoster, a logo under the pointer turns into a solid mark in the tile's text colour. A logo whose outline would only be a shapeless blob keeps its detail in greys instead. TorBox's cube no longer fades into its green tile.
- **The working folder says it is optional.** Its empty field reads "Empty: straight into the download folder", and its hint starts with Optional.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The container leaves update checks to the container manager.** In the container, Check automatically is greyed out like Update automatically, and opening the page no longer asks GitHub. Check for updates still works.
